1.summary: Order Import now rejects a row with a negative subtotal. One new check in the function that reads each row; nothing else changes.

sections.title: What changes
sections.text: `parseOrderRow()` throws when the subtotal is below zero. The row `A-3,-500,0` is rejected instead of importing as -500 cents.

sections.title: Why
sections.text: REQ-22: partner files sometimes carry a negative subtotal by mistake.

sections.title: What it reaches
sections.text: `importOrder()` in Order Import, the only caller of `parseOrderRow()`. Checkout does not read order rows.

sections.title: What is tested
sections.text: Order Import: three REQ-22 tests pass (negative row rejected, valid row still 105 cents, zero subtotal allowed).

sections.title: What stays the same
sections.text: Valid rows import at the same totals. A zero subtotal is still allowed.
